shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "ls -la && cat package.json && cat src/App.tsx && cat src/main.tsx && cat index.html && cat vite.config.ts && find .. -name AGENTS.md -not -path '*/node_modules/*' -print"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts && cat tsconfig.json && ls node_modules | rg 'playwright|puppeteer'"

/bin/bash -lc "node -e 'const fs=require(\"fs\");const p=\"index.html\";fs.writeFileSync(p,fs.readFileSync(p,\"utf8\").replace(\"lang=\\\"en\\\"\",\"lang=\\\"ru\\\"\").replace(\"Gravity UI eval\",\"Настройки профиля — Orbit\"))' && npm install --no-save --package-lock=false playwright && npx playwright --version"

/bin/bash -lc "npx --yes prettier@3.6.2 --write src/App.tsx src/styles.css index.html && node -e 'const fs=require(\"fs\");const p=\".gitignore\";const s=fs.readFileSync(p,\"utf8\");if("'!s.split("'"\\n\").includes(\"dist/\"))fs.appendFileSync(p,\"dist/\\n\")' && git diff --check"
